signin_error_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
signin_error_network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
not_invited_body: Water.it is invite-only, and {email} is not on the list. Ask Niko to invite this address, or sign out and use another account.
home_placeholder: Your plants and today's checks will appear here.
plants_failed: Could not load your plants. Check your connection.
plants_empty_body: Add your plants to see their care and when to check them.
plant_not_found_body: This plant no longer exists, or the link is wrong.
log_empty: Nothing logged yet. Watered, Still damp and Skip land here, and anything you add.
log_form_note_hint_problem: What does it look like? Yellow leaves, pests, a soft stem…
log_form_location_hint: Also changes where the plant is listed.
log_error_date: Pick a day that isn’t in the future.
log_delete_body: “{kind}” on {date} is removed from the log. It can’t be undone.
suggest_longer_growing: The soil was still damp before each of the last {rounds} waterings. Check every {to} days in the growing season, instead of {from}?
suggest_longer_resting: The soil was still damp before each of the last {rounds} waterings. Check every {to} days in winter, instead of {from}?
suggest_shorter_growing: You watered early the last {rounds} times. Check every {to} days in the growing season, instead of {from}?
suggest_shorter_resting: You watered early the last {rounds} times. Check every {to} days in winter, instead of {from}?
suggest_note: You can change it later in Edit.
care_watering_sparse: Water sparingly, and let it dry out well.
care_watering_intervals: Check every {growing} days when growing, {resting} when resting.
care_watering_fixed: Water every {growing} days when growing, {resting} when resting.
care_fertilize_growing: Every {days} days in the growing season, none when resting.
plant_care_source_edited: From the {preset} preset · edited by you: {fields}
signin_error_email: That doesn’t look like an email address.
reset_intro: Enter the email you sign in with. We’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
reset_sent: If there’s an account for {email}, a reset link is on its way. Open it, choose a new password, then come back here to sign in.
reset_google_note: Sign in with Google? Then there’s no password to reset — use Continue with Google.
add_species_intro: Pick a starting point. Its care profile fills in for you, and you can change anything on the next step.
add_search_placeholder: Search, e.g. pilea or money plant
add_search_none: No preset matches “{query}”. Pick a general starting point below, or start blank.
add_preset_missing_body: This link points to a preset that doesn’t exist. Choose the plant again.
settings_language_hint: Automatic follows your phone’s language. Changing it reloads the app.
settings_theme_hint: Automatic follows your phone’s light or dark setting.
add_first_check: First check: {date}. You can change everything later.
form_name_hint: What you call it. Shown on Today and in the plant list.
pot_hint_terracotta_pebbles: Terracotta dries faster. Pebbles hide the soil, so check with a skewer.
pot_hint_terracotta: Terracotta dries faster, so checks come a little sooner.
pot_hint_pebbles: Pebbles hide the soil, so check with a skewer or by lifting the pot.
pot_hint_damp: Plastic and glazed pots stay damp longer.
form_watering_from_preset: Filled in from the {preset} preset. Change anything that’s different for your plant.
form_watering_blank: Set how often to check it. You can fine-tune this as you learn the plant.
form_reminder_check_hint: Recommended. Remind me to check; water only if it’s dry.
form_reminder_fixed_hint: Remind me to water every time, no check.
form_grow_light_hint: Uses the growing-season interval all year.
form_dormant_hint: Uses the winter interval and pauses fertilizing.
form_more_hint: Light, water needs, temperature, fertilizing, repotting, watch-outs
form_fertilize_hint: Leave empty if it doesn’t need feeding.
form_error_days: Use a whole number of days, 1–{max}.
form_error_pot_size: Use a size between 1 and 200 cm.
form_error_comfort: Fill in both ends, with the lower one first.
form_error_fertilize: Use 1–365 days, or leave it empty.
form_error_repot: Use 1–120 months, or leave it empty.
edit_delete_note: Deleting removes its schedule and care log too. You’ll be asked to confirm.
delete_body: This removes the plant, its schedule and its care log. It can’t be undone.
species_change_intro: The care profile starts over from the new choice, and care fields you edited go back to its values. Name, pot, location and notes stay. Nothing is saved until you tap Save.

match.countPlural=one: 1 to check · tap the drop when watered
match.countPlural=other: {count} to check · tap the drop when watered

today_no_plants: Your plants’ checks will show up here.
today_dates_note: Dates move when you log something. A late watering pushes the next check later.
tip_growing_1: Plants drink more in warm weather. Check the soil a little more often.
tip_growing_2: Give pots a quarter turn now and then so plants grow evenly.
tip_growing_3: Spring is the time to repot: look for roots poking out of the drainage holes.
tip_growing_4: Move plants out of harsh midday sun in a south window so the leaves don’t scorch.
tip_growing_5: Feed during the growing season, following each plant’s fertilising interval.
tip_resting_1: Pots near a radiator dry out faster. Lift them now and then to feel the weight.
tip_resting_2: Light is scarce in winter. Move sun-lovers closer to the window, but keep leaves off the cold glass.
tip_resting_3: Most plants rest now. Leave the fertiliser until spring.
tip_resting_4: Water with room-temperature water. Cold tap water stresses the roots.
tip_resting_5: Wipe the dust off broad leaves so they catch what little light there is.
backup_hint: Your plants, care log and reminders in one file, to keep wherever you like. Everything is already stored online; this is a copy of your own.
backup_error: Couldn’t make the backup. Try again.
storage_granted: Kept, even when the device runs low on space.
storage_not_granted: The device may clear it when space runs low. Nothing is lost: it downloads again when you’re online.
